name: ocr_noise
description: Recogniser noise: contractions split (don't), hyphenated compounds, number written as digits vs words, wrong homophones, dropped and inserted words, OCR-style typos in the ebook.
segments: "Don't touch that," Margaret said, but it was already too late.
The well-known inventor had left his machine running since 1984, and nobody dared to switch it off.
Its gears turned slowly, tick by tick, measuring something no one understood.
Tbe children gathered around it every evening.
They whispered their theories: a clock for ghosts, a counter of rainy days, a heart made of brass.
Margaret thought it was simply waiting.
